# Boggles on the Road

*Corwell's caravans come up later every month, and the Dust Boggles on the Canyon Road are part of why. Hunt 40 of them.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Midbarium](../towns/midbarium_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Corwell](../npcs/corwell.md) |
| Level | 14 |
| Leads to | [Traders from the Woods](../quests/corwell_traders_from_the_woods.md) |

## Objectives

- Defeat 40 [Dust Boggle](../monsters/dust_boggle.md) in [The Canyon Road](../maps/canyon_road.md)

## Rewards

- 1,350 EXP
- 280 mesos
- [White Potion](../items/white_potion.md) x10
- +20 standing with Midbarium
- +30 standing with [Corwell](../npcs/corwell.md)
